title: POV: You Wake Up in Pompeii, 24 Hours Before the Eruption #shorts
hook_text: POV: YOU WAKE UP IN POMPEII
description:
It's 79 AD. You wake up in Pompeii, a busy Roman city at the foot of Mount Vesuvius. In about 24 hours, it will be buried under ash. Would you have left in time?

Images are AI-generated recreations based on archaeological findings.

#pompeii #history #ancientrome #pov #lostworlds
image_style: cinematic documentary film still, shot on ARRI Alexa with a 35mm lens, soft natural light, realistic weathered textures, muted earthy color palette, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, historically accurate 1st century Roman details, ultra detailed, no text, no logo, no watermark

scenes.text: You wake up in Pompeii, 79 AD. In twenty-four hours, this city will be buried alive.
scenes.image: over-the-shoulder view of a person sitting up in a small Pompeii bedroom at dawn, red and ochre fresco walls, simple wooden bed with rough wool blanket, golden sunlight through a small high window, dust in the air

scenes.text: Bakers pull round loaves from stone ovens. Archaeologists will find loaves like these, turned to charcoal, two thousand years later.
scenes.image: interior of an ancient Roman bakery in Pompeii, glowing brick dome oven, round bread loaves divided into eight segments on a wooden board, grey lava stone grain mills, baker in a plain linen tunic dusted with flour

scenes.text: You grab lunch at a street counter. Hot food served from jars built into the stone. Roman fast food.
scenes.image: ancient Roman street food counter in Pompeii, large terracotta jars sunk into a marble counter, faded painted fresco of animals on the counter front, locals in tunics eating, warm midday light

scenes.text: The walls are covered in painted slogans and graffiti. People here write on everything.
scenes.image: narrow stone-paved street in Pompeii with raised stepping stones, walls covered in red painted Latin slogans and scratched graffiti, wooden shop shutters, people walking, late morning light

scenes.text: Some buildings still show cracks from a massive earthquake years ago.
scenes.image: Roman builders on wooden scaffolding repairing a large crack in a plastered brick wall in Pompeii, buckets of mortar, rope and pulleys, busy street below

scenes.text: Then the ground trembles. Nobody panics. Small quakes happen here all the time.
scenes.image: the forum of Pompeii with tall stone columns, citizens and merchants going about their day, a thin trickle of dust falling from a column, calm atmosphere

scenes.text: Above the city, Vesuvius is green and covered in vineyards. Almost no one sees it as a threat.
scenes.image: wide landscape of green Mount Vesuvius covered in terraced vineyards rising behind the red roofs of Pompeii, clear blue sky, peaceful afternoon, grape harvest workers in the foreground

scenes.text: That night, you fall asleep like everyone else.
scenes.image: dark Roman bedroom at night lit by a single small bronze oil lamp, a person asleep under a wool blanket, deep warm shadows, quiet and peaceful

scenes.text: Tomorrow, around midday, the mountain will explode. Ash and stones will rain down for hours.
scenes.image: enormous dark eruption column rising from Mount Vesuvius high above Pompeii, ash cloud spreading across the sky, people in the street below staring up in fear

scenes.text: Most will run. Those who stay will be frozen in time. Would you have left?
scenes.image: empty street of Pompeii buried under grey ash and pumice stones, dim orange sky, eerie silence, abandoned cart and fallen amphora
